Method of Attack: Disguised as game cheat tools (e.g., aimbot, wall hack) to trick users into downloading
RUSThack.exe extracts and executes svchost.exe (legitimate Microsoft Visual Basic Command Line Compiler) to inject AZORult DLL
AZORult steals browser and FTP passwords, browser history, and other data
RUSThack.exe copies itself to %Temp%\FolderN and configures auto-start on Windows login
Attackers use fake game hacks, fake Windows Updates, cracked VPN installations, and key generators to spread AZORult
Attack Vector: Download links from YouTube videos offering free game hacks (e.g., mega.nz links)
User disables antivirus as instructed by TUTORIAL.txt to allow cheat injector to run
Indicators of Compromise: svchost.exe extracted to %Temp% folder (legitimate Microsoft compiler used maliciously)
Mega.nz download links in YouTube video descriptions by user Pirate Hack
